name: synthia
description: Synthia - one runtime, every piece ingested, nothing thrown away.

scripts.serve: node -e "const {createServer}=require('node:http');const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const port=8080;const types={'.html':'text/html','.mjs':'text/javascript','.js':'text/javascript','.json':'application/json','.ts':'text/plain','.md':'text/plain'};createServer((req,res)=>{let p=decodeURIComponent(req.url.split('?')[0]);if(p==='/')p='/index.html';const full=path.join(process.cwd(),p);fs.readFile(full,(err,data)=>{if(err){res.writeHead(404);res.end('not found: '+p);return;}res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':types[path.extname(full)]||'application/octet-stream'});res.end(data);});}).listen(port,()=>console.log('Synthia serving on http://localhost:'+port));"
scripts.verify: npm run smoke && npm run smoke:orchestrator && npm run smoke:visual && npm run smoke:scene && npm run smoke:contact && npm run smoke:browser && npm run smoke:navigation && npm run smoke:continuation && npm test
